examined_formations.title: CHINA_DIGITAL_INVOICE_REIMBURSEMENT_VERIFICATION_AND_ARCHIVE_PREPARATION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 中国数电票报销查验与归档准备的重复数字操作
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: A May 2026 Chinese developer described being a frequent reimbursement user and manually taking official tax-verification screenshots, cropping and renaming them, locating XML originals, checking duplicates and organizing invoice files before finance submission.
The participant built a small tool specifically to automate those repeated digital steps, demonstrating an attempted state change rather than a hypothetical complaint.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: China's electronic voucher accounting data standard explicitly supports XML digital invoices and is intended to solve electronic-voucher receipt, reimbursement, accounting and archiving friction.

Tax digital accounts can automatically deliver digital invoices, and official tax guidance supports PDF, OFD and XML download/retention, so the underlying artifacts are already digital and participant-accessible.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: Employees download invoice files from different channels, obtain verification evidence, rename and deduplicate files, then upload or forward them into employer reimbursement workflows.

The participant-created tool automates official verification screenshots plus multi-format retrieval, while enterprise expense products already automate invoice collection, validation, reimbursement, accounting and archive preparation.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: The decisive preparation steps are digitally executable under the user's own access, satisfying the Scan 097 entrance better than physical or authority-controlled formations.

However the deterministic work is highly substitutable: current enterprise platforms already provide one-stop digital-invoice collection, automatic verification, duplicate detection and compliant archiving, while small personal tools can reproduce the employee-side preparation layer.
economic_signal: The work has real employer-side cost because finance teams process reimbursement and archive electronic credentials at scale.
But employee-side willingness to pay for a standalone preparation utility is not independently proven, and enterprise spend already lands on mature expense/finance platforms.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: Hose/合思 currently markets digital-invoice collection, automatic verification, reimbursement, accounting and archiving as one end-to-end expense-control workflow.
泛微业票通 likewise provides automated invoice collection, validation and linkage into reimbursement/accounting/archive systems.
The official standard requires accounting software vendors to adapt within the implementation window, increasing native-platform absorption pressure.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_MULTI_PLATFORM_CREATOR_PUBLISHING_AND_ACCOUNT_STATE_TRANSFER
examined_formations.chinese_title: 中国创作者多平台内容发布与账号状态搬运
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: A July 2026 Chinese creator/developer reported running content automation across six platforms and 300 videos, explicitly automating the upload workflow rather than manually operating each platform.

A July 2026 developer of a multi-platform publishing tool described the residual last mile directly: AI can create content, but distribution still requires manual pasting, tagging and format adjustment unless the creator reuses logged-in browser sessions.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: Creators already own the source content plus their authenticated platform accounts; the repeated state transfer is from one local content package into multiple creator backends.
Current open-source projects demonstrate that logged-in browser state can drive real publishing to domestic platforms without a neutral central API.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: Creators use browser automation, local cookies, Playwright/Electron tools, CLI and MCP interfaces to reuse their own logged-in sessions and batch-publish.
When platform UI or anti-abuse flows change, tools require adapter maintenance and may fall back to manual confirmation.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: The decisive submission action occurs inside participant-authorized digital accounts and is highly machine-executable, matching the Scan 097 control-rights filter.
Yet the exact category is crowded with active open-source and commercial tools supporting overlapping Chinese platforms, and general browser agents can reproduce much of the same operation.
economic_signal: Repeated publishing consumes creator/operator time and commercial tools sell subscriptions around the workflow.

Current free/open-source alternatives and low technical differentiation compress durable standalone margin unless a distinct proprietary distribution asset or outcome advantage exists; none is evidenced here.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: Active 2026 tools include MatrixMedia, PublishPort, MediaSync, MultiPublish, OmniPost and other browser-automation projects covering Douyin, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, WeChat Channels and additional platforms.
MediaSync explicitly uses the creator's existing browser login state and the same web-editor interfaces used manually; MultiPublish verifies publication by checking the official backend.
The participant owns account access, but destination platforms still own interface rules, anti-abuse controls and final content acceptance.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_ANDROID_MULTI_STORE_RELEASE_SUBMISSION_AND_METADATA_REPETITION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 中国 Android 多应用商店发版、材料与元数据重复提交
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: A February 2026 Chinese developer preparing a tool app for Xiaomi, OPPO, vivo and Tencent asked whether each store still requires separate accounts and flows and whether one-click multi-store publishing exists.
A separate April 2026 developer described returning to app publishing and the current burden of Android store qualifications, filing and multi-channel distribution.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: The developer already possesses the APK, release notes, screenshots, privacy links and store accounts or can obtain them; the repeated operation is digitally transferring similar release state to multiple store consoles.
Current DCloud documentation shows partial multi-store upload support but still requires separate developer accounts, identity verification and, for some stores, manual app creation or first release.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: Developers register multiple store accounts, prepare common compliance materials, create app records and submit binaries/metadata to each store.
Current tooling such as DCloud multi-store upload and apkgo uses each developer's own store credentials to parallelize submission and expose machine-consumable result states.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: The upload/update actions are primarily participant-authorized digital actions and can be automated once credentials and app records exist.

But exact current products already provide one-command or hosted multi-store publishing, while store review, policy rejection, qualification and some first-release metadata remain external authoritative decisions.
economic_signal: Developer time and release delay have economic cost, and apkgo now has a hosted commercial offering plus commercial-use licensing paths, proving some willingness to pay for release orchestration.
That same evidence also shows the category is already directly occupied; no separate control surface or unserved payer segment is proven.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: DCloud's current uni multi-store upload supports first publication to several stores and documents which stores still require manual creation or first release.
apkgo currently offers one-command upload to major Android stores, CI/CD integration, agent-friendly interfaces and a hosted cloud service.
Xiaomi and alliance policies retain store-side compliance/review authority; successful upload is not equivalent to approval.
